issue.title: CaptureTaskGotoPanelTests.testLateFailureAfterChipReopenSuccessHasNoEffect flakes on macOS CI

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by bob-cli-q5.8.1.6.5.1.1--2 (bob-cli-q5.8.1.6.5.1.1 note #5, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP), carried forward by bob-cli-q5.9.1.7 note #6, and triaged by the bob-cli-q5.9.1 land agent.

- Repo: bob-mac-capture (linked). Test body at `Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/CaptureTaskGotoPanelTests.swift:507`.
- Observed: failed once on exact-SHA macOS CI for snapshot `ba213181` (GitHub Actions run 45960329324, attempt 1, 2026-11-27). Attempt 2 on the same SHA was green (completed 12:20:58Z).
- Fail rate so far: 1 failure in 2 CI attempts on an unchanged tree. Not reproduced serially. The full SwiftPM suite runs tests in parallel on the macOS 26 runner.
- The failing run's commit was snooze acceptance-harness work. It did not touch the Go To panel, so the flake is not caused by the snooze epic (bob-cli-q5).
- No existing task bead tracks CaptureTaskGotoPanelTests flakes. bob-cli-h7 (closed) covered a deterministic Go To CI break, not this async ordering case.
- Likely area (read, not proven): the test asserts that a late failure from an earlier chip-reopen request cannot undo a later success. A timing-dependent await, or an unguarded generation check in the panel's Go To fetch path, would explain an intermittent order inversion under CI load.
- First step: pull the failing attempt's log (run 45960329324 attempt 1) for the assertion message, then loop the test under `swift test --filter CaptureTaskGotoPanelTests` on macOS (or `Scripts/macos-ci-check`) to estimate the rate.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: Scripts/macos-ci-check (exact-SHA macOS CI; run 45960329324 attempt 1 failed, attempt 2 passed)
